blocks.text: We are closing at one tomorrow so everyone can get a head start on the holiday, and the office will be dark on the Fourth. Coverage next week is light with people away, so I want the essentials handled before we all scatter.

Michelle Rose has the mailbox and any drafts that land Wednesday and Thursday, and Michael Morris will be in both days if anything needs a partner's eye. If you are out and expecting something time-sensitive, tell Michelle before you go so nothing sits unanswered.
Let me know by the end of today if your coverage does not hold, and enjoy the long weekend.
